skill.displayName: 门诊收费与退费日结核对（免费版）

llm.summary: This skill is a local, deterministic checker for clinic cashier daily reconciliation tables, with no evidence of network use, persistence, credential access, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash access are proportionate to running the local Node checker; the code reads only the specified input file and bundled engine, and static review found no network, environment-variable, credential, or broad filesystem access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, dependency fetch, package manager step, or remote payload is present; the skill consists of SKILL.md, a local runner, a local engine, and a sample JSON file.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions tell the user to run a bundled Node script on a sample or user-supplied input file; there are no prompt overrides, role changes, hidden agent instructions, or unrelated task expansion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, scheduled tasks, shell profile changes, services, memory writes, privilege escalation, background workers, or authentication/session handling were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to verify arithmetic, totals, duplicates, blanks, and negative values in outpatient cashier daily reconciliation tables; the bundled engine implements that same scope and discloses withheld paid checks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable running a local Node.js script on clinic reconciliation data. The skill appears to keep processing local and does not request registration, payment, API keys, credentials, or network access, but its interface and output are primarily Chinese and it only performs the free subset of checks it lists.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file is present in the artifact and was fully inspected; invoking a bundled local script is consistent with the skill's documented workflow.
[SQP-3] expected: The skill is clearly aimed at a Chinese-language clinic accounting workflow and most user-facing text is Chinese; this is a locale/usability limitation rather than evidence of unsafe behavior.
[SDI-4] unexpected: One inline comment mentions pasted contract text, which is inconsistent documentation, but the actual usage text and implementation consistently process cashier reconciliation table input.
